## What changes, and why

<!-- The reason matters more than the diff. If it fixes something, say what
     the symptom was; the person reading this in a year is you. -->

## What you checked

<!-- Delete what does not apply. -->

- [ ] `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm i18n:check` — touched a translation catalogue
- [ ] `pnpm contrast:check` — touched a dashboard colour
- [ ] `pnpm db:generate` committed alongside — changed the schema
- [ ] Documentation updated in **both** languages, or the pair is flagged as out of sync

## What you did not check

<!-- Being explicit costs one line and saves a review round. "I could not test
     against a real number" is a perfectly good answer, and the honest one for
     almost everything that touches the last hop. -->
